summary: Built-in sales reports in Business Central: analysis reports (receivables aging, customer balances, orders, top customers, salesperson commission) and printable sales documents (quotes, order confirmations, invoices, credit memos, shipments, return receipts). Answers questions about what each report shows, its filters and options, and its layouts.
overview:
This section lists the standard sales reports that ship with Business Central. It starts with a Sales report overview page, which explains how to reach sales reports through Report Explorer and links to ad-hoc analysis, the Power BI sales app, and sales analytics.

The other pages fall into a few groups. Analysis reports cover receivables and customers (Aged Accounts Receivable Excel report, Customer - Balance to Date, Trial Balance, Order Detail, Order Summary, Top List, Customer/Item Sales, Day Book Customer Ledger Entry) and salespeople (Commission, Sales Statistics). Inventory-related reports cover order details, picking lists and back orders. Document reports print customer-facing documents: Standard Sales quote, order confirmation, draft invoice, invoice, pro forma invoice, credit memo, shipment and return receipt. Variants add subscription contract billing, QR codes, or sustainability (CO2e) data.

Start with the overview page, then open the page for the report you need. Document report pages mostly describe filters (document number, customer number, printed tracking), optional archiving or interaction logging, and RDLC or Word layouts.
key_points: Sales report overview explains access through Report Explorer and links to ad-hoc analysis, the Power BI sales app and sales analytics.
Aged Accounts Receivable (Excel) buckets customer ledger entries by due date using Aged as of and Period length parameters, with four worksheets for LCY and FCY analysis.

Customer reports include Balance to Date (open entries at an ending date), Trial Balance (by posting group, with beginning balance, debits, credits, ending balance), Order Detail, Order Summary (three 30-day periods) and Top List (Excel, ranked by sales or balance LCY).
Salesperson - Commission and Salesperson - Sales Statistics cover commission (sales or profit based) and sales, profit, discount and payment totals for a period.
Inventory reports cover Order Details, Picking List (quantity to ship with location and bin codes) and Sales Back Orders (overdue shipments by item).

Standard document reports (quote, order confirmation, draft invoice, invoice, credit memo, shipment, return receipt, pro forma invoice) offer filters and options such as archiving, interaction logging, zero-quantity line hiding and assembly components.
Contract variants of the quote, order confirmation and invoice reports add subscription billing and service commitment sections grouped by billing period.
Posted Sales Invoice with QR and Credit Memo with QR add QR codes in Word layouts; Sust. invoice and quote reports add CO2e per unit, total CO2e and a disclaimer per Sustainability Setup.
